title: Senior Staff Data Scientist, Product
description:
**Overview**
------------

Intuit Global Business Solutions Group (GBSG) Data Science has an exciting opportunity to be part of the fast-growing Mid-market Data Science team that plays a critical role in driving growth with a long-term winning strategy. Disrupting the small business mid-market is one of Intuit's 3 Big Bets initiatives. We are looking for a Senior Staff Data Scientist to serve as an analytical leader and strategic thought partner for our Mid-market Product Growth initiatives.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role where you will set the analytics and measurement vision, raise the scientific bar, and influence product and business strategy for the mid-market segment. You will partner closely with senior leaders across Product, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering, and Design to identify the biggest growth opportunities across the end-to-end customer journey—from acquisition and activation to habit formation and long-term retention.

Intuit has embraced a hybrid working model and this role will be based out of our Mountain View office 3 days per week.

**Responsibilities**

* **Influence Product Strategy:** Serve as a strategic thought partner to senior Product and Business leaders (up to EVP-level). Influence product strategy by conducting deep-dive analyses on customer segmentation, funnel optimization, product adoption, and voice of the customer.
* **Set the Analytics Vision:** Establish the measurement architecture, key success metrics, and leading indicators used to evaluate the health and growth of the Mid-market product ecosystem.
* **Lead Experimentation & Causal Measurement:** Drive an iterative experimentation culture by designing complex experiments (A/B/n, multi-armed bandits) and applying causal inference methodologies (e.g., Propensity Score Matching, Difference-in-Differences) where traditional A/B testing is limited.
* **Shape the AI-Native Roadmap:** Develop ML models and LLM applications to address complex product problems. Partner with product and engineering teams to integrate intelligent personalization, lead scoring, and generative AI features into the customer experience.
* **Uncover Growth Opportunities:** Use first-principles thinking and data mining to proactively explore and identify new business opportunities across the funnel, quantifying potential impact to guide investment prioritization.
* **Raise the Scientific Bar & Mentorship:** Create reusable analytical frameworks, methodologies, and tools that improve decision-making at scale. Coach, mentor, and elevate junior data scientists on the team while remaining hands-on with the highest-leverage problems.
* Serve as a tech team lead and supervise a team of 3-5 senior to staff data scientist.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 8+ years of experience in data science, product analytics, or related fields, with a proven track record of driving strategy and measurable business impact. Experience in B2B SaaS or fintech is highly preferred.
* **Technical Mastery:** Highly proficient in AI-native data science tech stack (Claude/Cursor/Codex + MCPs/CLIs/APIs). Expert-level proficiency in SQL and Complext Data Modeling. Advanced practical experience applying machine learning (classification, regression, ranking) and LLMs / GenAI workflows to real-world product problems.
* **Experimentation Rigor:** Deep expertise in experimentation, causal inference, and advanced customer segmentation, with the judgment to balance statistical rigor with business realities.
* **First-Principles Problem Solving:** Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business strategies into clear analytical frameworks and actionable product decisions.
* **Executive Communication:** Exceptional storytelling and stakeholder influence skills, with the ability to communicate complex data concepts effectively to non-technical audiences and senior executives.
* **Education:** Minimum Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or related).

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The expected base pay range for this position is:
  
Mountain View $210,500 - $284,500

title: Software Engineer, Research Tooling
description:
Engineering · Full-time · Palo Alto, CA

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **About the role**

As a Software Engineer on the Research Tools team, you'll build the infrastructure and applications that enable our researchers to iterate quickly, run complex experiments, and extract insights. This is a full-stack product-engineering role.

You'll work directly with researchers and engineers to deeply understand their workflows, identify bottlenecks, and rapidly ship solutions that multiply their productivity. Whether you're creating platforms for experiment orchestration, developing novel visualization tools for model evaluation, or building abstractions for understanding model behavior at scale, your work will directly accelerate our mission of building frontier AI models.

We're looking for someone who can jump into new problems, quickly develop domain expertise, and independently drive impactful projects from conception to delivery. No prior ML or research experience is required.

### **What you’ll do**

* Build and maintain the full-stack applications and infrastructure researchers rely on daily, covering experiment setup, feedback collection, and results analysis.
* Own complete product areas from user needs through design, implementation, and iteration, setting standards for how to build research applications.
* Create reusable platforms and tools that speed up new research applications, then prototype, ship, and iterate quickly based on real-world usage.
* Partner with research teams to turn their workflows and pain points into intuitive interfaces and abstractions that make complex research tasks fast and approachable.

### **You may be a fit if**

* You’ve had experience building tools, platforms, or infrastructure for technical users (engineers, researchers, data scientists, analysts, etc.)
* You’ve shipped full-stack products and owned systems from user interface to storage or services, using technologies such as TypeScript and React alongside Node, Python, or Go.
* You’ve built dense, data-facing tools such as transcript viewers, diffing systems, review queues, observability products, or operational dashboards—and you have strong opinions about how structured data should be rendered.
* You have strong product instincts, can identify the right problems to solve, and can move from concept to working prototype with ease.
* You move quickly under ambiguity, collaborate closely with researchers and domain experts, and take open-ended problems from rough need to reliable product.

### **ing**

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2-3 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. AWS is seeking an experienced Customer Success Specialist for Communication Developer Services (CDS), covering AWS End User Messaging and Amazon Simple Email Service (SES), with a focus on Applied AI. CDS lets customers reach their audiences across every major channel (email, SMS, RCS, push, and WhatsApp) at scale. As communication moves from one-way notifications toward conversational and agentic AI, customer success is where that transformation is realized in production. As a CDS Customer Success Specialist, you will be a strategic advisor who helps customers onboard, ramp, and optimize their messaging and AI-driven communication workloads, leading cross-functional field teams across sales, solutions architecture, partner, and product.  
  
The ideal candidate will have customer success, technical account management, or consulting experience with messaging, communications, or similar SaaS solutions (CPaaS, SMS/messaging, marketing technology, CRM/CDP), and a genuine interest in how AI is reshaping customer engagement. You bring technical depth, comfortable getting hands-on with the services, reasoning about architecture and integration, and guiding customers through configuration and troubleshooting, and you partner with Solutions Architects on the most specialized builds. You are passionate about customer advocacy and bring the voice of the customer into the product development process.  
  
Note on the Applied AI focus: this role centers on leading customer adoption of AI-driven communication and realizing value from it — hands-on AI-practitioner experience (e.g. data scientist or ML engineer) is welcome but not the focus.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of strategic customer accounts, acting as a strategic advisor and driving enterprise-wide adoption of CDS services.
* Own onboarding and ramp. Drive time-to-first-value, remove technical and operational blockers, and coordinate with SA and support to get customers to production quickly.
* Own the expand & churn motion. Monitor customer health and adoption, forecast usage, identify growth opportunities, and address at-risk accounts before churn, while meeting annual revenue and retention targets.
* Guide customers adopting conversational and agentic-AI communication patterns, helping them apply AI-driven engagement responsibly on top of CDS channels.
* Build repeatable, scalable assets such as playbooks, best-practices, and reusable programs, so adoption patterns work across your portfolio rather than one account at a time.
* Deliver compelling presentations, product demos, sample solutions and programs, events, and discussions to enable customer success.
* Build customer skills and proficiency with CDS (deliverability, compliance, and multi-channel best practices).
* Engage with senior stakeholders to understand the value proposition of CDS and uncover new areas of business value.
* Develop account plans in conjunction with field teams, and work with partners and ISVs to extend reach and drive adoption of AWS solutions.

  
A day in the life  
Your morning starts in your portfolio's health dashboard: one account's send volume dipped, another stalled in onboarding. You jump on a working session with a Solutions Architect to clear a deliverability blocker and get a customer to production. Midday, you advise a customer's senior stakeholders on their roadmap from one-way messaging toward conversational and agentic AI on CDS channels, then build the account plan with your sales team. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance

**Job Description**

**Director, Stablecoin & Digital Assets Risk Intelligence, AI Strategy and Governance**
=======================================================================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

The **Director, Stablecoin & Digital Assets Risk Intelligence, AI Strategy and Governance** will own the long-term vision, strategy, architecture, governance, and execution of Visa’s stablecoin, digital asset, and AI-enabled risk intelligence capabilities. Reporting to the Senior Director of the Global CSR team, the Director will lead a team of three and serve as a strategic leader at the intersection of digital asset risk management, emerging technologies, artificial intelligence, data governance, and enterprise risk strategy.

This role requires **deep subject matter expertise in stablecoins, digital assets, blockchain infrastructure, and crypto risk management**, combined with advanced experience designing, deploying, governing, and scaling enterprise AI systems. The successful candidate will be responsible for anticipating evolving stablecoin risks, market structures, technologies, regulatory developments, and AI-driven transformation opportunities while building the governance, analytical, operational, and decision-support capabilities necessary to enable responsible growth.

The Director will act as a key advisor to executive leadership, driving innovation across risk intelligence platforms, AI-enabled workflows, governance frameworks, and enterprise decision-making processes.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Stablecoin & Digital Asset Risk Strategy and Governance**

* Establish and maintain enterprise-wide risk appetite, governance frameworks, approval standards, and ongoing monitoring requirements for stablecoin issuers, digital asset counterparties, crypto infrastructure providers, custodians, exchanges, and blockchain-based financial ecosystems.
* Serve as Visa’s subject matter expert on stablecoin risk management, reserve risk, de-pegging scenarios, liquidity events, blockchain vulnerabilities, custody risks, market contagion, and regulatory developments.
* Design governance mechanisms and risk frameworks that support responsible growth across digital asset initiatives.

### **Portfolio, Exposure and Liquidity Risk Management**

* Develop scalable methodologies for settlement exposure management, concentration limits, liquidity risk, collateral frameworks, reserve assessments, stress testing, scenario modeling, and portfolio monitoring.
* Design advanced risk intelligence capabilities to evaluate stablecoin reserve quality, counterparty financial strength, operational resiliency, and systemic market exposures.
* Lead enterprise-level assessments of digital asset ecosystem risks, including custody, settlement, treasury, and operational dependencies.

### **Digital Asset Risk Intelligence and Executive Reporting**

* Lead proactive surveillance and intelligence functions across stablecoins, digital assets, blockchain networks, and crypto markets.
* Translate financial, regulatory, market, cyber, operational, and on-chain signals into actionable intelligence, executive reporting, risk recommendations, and escalation decisions.
* Develop predictive analytics and early-warning indicators supporting executive and Board-level risk oversight.

### **AI Architecture, Strategy and Platform Leadership**

* Own the vision, roadmap, investment strategy, and architecture for Visa’s Stablecoin and Digital Assets Risk Intelligence Platform.
* Design and deploy next-generation AI-enabled capabilities supporting risk detection, monitoring, reporting, decision support, workflow automation, and operational efficiency.
* Lead the development of scalable enterprise AI frameworks leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), generative AI, predictive analytics, machine learning, and intelligent automation capabilities.
* Drive the integration of AI technologies into risk operations while ensuring transparency, explain ability, governance, and regulatory compliance.

### **Enterprise AI Governance and Responsible AI Frameworks**

* Design and implement enterprise AI governance programs, policies, controls, standards, and oversight processes.
* Establish governance frameworks supporting model validation, explain ability, bias monitoring, human oversight, auditability, data lineage, and regulatory compliance.
* Define approval standards and control frameworks for AI-enabled decisioning systems utilized across risk management and business operations.
* Create governance models that balance innovation with regulatory expectations and enterprise risk management requirements.

### **AI Workflow Automation and Operating Model Transformation**

* Design, build, and optimize AI-supported workflows, decision support systems, and operating models across risk management functions.
* Identify opportunities to increase operational effectiveness through AI-enabled automation, intelligent case management, workflow orchestration, and digital assistants.
* Develop enterprise capabilities that leverage advanced AI platforms including **ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Gemini, and other emerging AI technologies**.
* Establish standards for AI adoption, prompt governance, workflow design, performance monitoring, and organizational enablement.

### **Enterprise Operating Model Leadership**

* Partner across Treasury, Product, Technology, Legal, Compliance, Data Science, Crypto, AI Engineering, and CSR functions to align strategic priorities and governance standards.
* Establish clear decision rights, accountability structures, controls, escalation protocols, and operating mechanisms for digital asset and AI initiatives.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders on emerging risks, opportunities, and technology innovation.

### **Regulatory Foresight and Operational Resilience**

* Anticipate regulatory developments impacting stablecoins, digital assets, AI systems, and emerging financial technologies.
* Advise leadership on risk implications associated with liquidity disruptions, reserve impairment, cyber incidents, blockchain failures, digital asset market volatility, sanctions concerns, AI-related operational risks, and other material events.
* Ensure enterprise readiness through scenario planning, contingency frameworks, and resilience testing.

### **Data, AI Model and Control Governance**

* Establish standards and accountability for data quality, AI model performance, model risk management, explain ability, validation, access management, control testing, and independent review processes.
* Develop governance frameworks supporting AI lifecycle management from design through deployment and ongoing monitoring.
* Ensure effective human oversight and decision accountability for AI-driven processes and recommendations.

Client Impact
  
  
You’ll primarily work alongside our case (engagement) teams in a client-serving role, responsibilities including:

* Support teams with the engagement of prospective clients and help build our commercial plan to increase our competitiveness by bringing differentiated expertise and capability

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **Job Description**

Position Summary

The Sr. Manager, Regulatory Affairs for the Digital Portfolio leads regulatory strategy and execution for software-driven products, including software as a medical device (SaMD), software in a medical device (SiMD), cloud and connected applications, data and analytics tools, and AI/ML-enabled features that support surgical care. This leader builds and manages a team of regulatory professionals and serves as the senior regulatory voice to Digital, R&D, Quality, Clinical, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Legal, and Commercial partners. The role ensures that digital innovations reach customers quickly, compliantly, and sustainably across global markets.

Key Responsibilities

**Regulatory Strategy and Leadership**

Develop and execute global regulatory strategies for digital products, aligned with business priorities and product roadmaps.

Determine device classification, qualification, and pathway for software functions, including whether features meet the definition of a medical device or fall under enforcement discretion.

Advise cross-functional leaders on regulatory risk, timelines, and trade-offs early in the design process.

Represent Regulatory Affairs on digital product core teams and governance forums.

Manage the regulatory assessment and ongoing oversight of the non-medical device portfolio of products, including determining non-device status, maintaining supporting rationale and documentation, and ensuring claims, labeling, and software updates do not change a product's regulatory status.

**Submissions and Market Authorization**

Lead preparation, review, and submission of 510(k), De Novo, and other premarket submissions.

Own regulatory strategy for software change management, including determining when changes require new submissions and leveraging Predetermined Change Control Plans (PCCPs) where appropriate.

Lead interactions with FDA including pre-submission meetings and responses to deficiency requests.

**Software, AI/ML, and Cybersecurity Expertise**

Apply FDA software guidance and consensus standards (e.g., IEC 62304, IEC 82304-1, IEC 62366-1, ISO 14971, IEC 81001-5-1) to digital product development and documentation.

Guide regulatory strategy for AI/ML-enabled functionality, including model transparency, validation, data management, bias assessment, lifecycle monitoring, and change control; monitor evolving requirements such as the EU AI Act.

Ensure premarket cybersecurity expectations are met (e.g., FD&C Act Section 524B, SBOM, threat modeling, vulnerability management, postmarket plans) in partnership with Product Security.

Partner with Privacy and Legal on the interplay between medical device regulation and data protection requirements (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR).

**Lifecycle and Compliance**

Review and approve design changes, labeling, instructions for use, and promotional/digital content for regulatory compliance.

Support postmarket activities including complaint and adverse event assessment, field actions, and regulatory reporting for software issues.

Support inspections and audits (FDA, MDSAP) and contribute to quality system procedures for software and digital development.

Maintain regulatory intelligence on digital health, SaMD, AI, and cybersecurity regulations; assess impact and drive proactive readiness.

**People Leadership**

Recruit, develop, coach, and retain a high-performing team; set clear goals, allocate work, and foster an inclusive, collaborative culture.

Build scalable processes, templates, and tools that improve submission quality and speed.

Manage department priorities, resourcing, and budget for the digital portfolio.

Qualifications

**Required**

Bachelor's degree in engineering, life sciences, computer science, or a related technical field.

8+ years of regulatory affairs experience in medical devices, including 3+ years of direct experience with software, SaMD, or digital health products.

Demonstrated success leading US premarket submissions for software-containing devices.

Working knowledge of FDA regulations (21 CFR 820 / QMSR, 21 CFR Part 11), EU MDR, and software lifecycle and cybersecurity requirements.

3+ years of experience leading or managing people or cross-functional project teams.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and regulators.

**Preferred**

Master's degree or advanced degree in a relevant field.

Experience with AI/ML-enabled medical devices, PCCPs, and cloud-based or connected platforms.

Experience with robotic-assisted surgery, surgical data, or enterprise-scale digital ecosystems.

Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC) or equivalent.

Experience with global markets beyond the US and EU, and direct health authority engagement.

**Technical fluency:** Engages credibly with software engineers, data scientists, and security experts.

**Influence and collaboration:** Builds trust across functions and drives decisions without relying on authority.

description:
**Company Description**

Chooch helps build and run the best Computer Vision AI applications that make cameras intelligent, enhancing productivity & revenues, while reducing operational costs. Chooch has been named a leading computer vision platform by IDC.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer (US-based) to join our team. This is a full-time, hybrid role with frequent hands-on experience with customer projects in the Bay Area. The Machine Learning Engineer will be responsible for the successful design, accuracy, and backbone behind our Computer Vision AI applications. This includes data preparation, training, configuring neural networks, deploying networks in real customer locations, and refining computer vision algorithms for healthcare, manufacturing, and retail customers. This role requires frequent interaction with technical and non-technical customers while working closely within our solutions engineering teams. The Machine Learning Engineering role has opportunity to grow, lead technical projects, and improve current processes while providing meaningful feedback to our product and solutions teams.

**Product Description** Chooch AI is a computer vision platform that helps hospitals automate supply room monitoring and inventory management. Using fixed cameras and AI, the platform continuously tracks supplies in storage areas and updates on-hand counts in real time. When inventory levels fall below defined thresholds, replenishment orders are automatically generated and sent to ERP systems, eliminating manual counts and barcode scanning. Hospitals using Chooch AI significantly reduce critical stockouts, optimize inventory levels, and improve supply chain staff productivity. By turning supply rooms into self-managing systems, Chooch AI enables clinical and supply chain teams to focus more time on patient care.

Responsibilities/What you'll do at Chooch:

* Design, train and fine-tune models for object detection, classification, segmentation, tracking and anomaly detection on real customer video and images.
* Adapt pretrained and foundation models (YOLO-family detectors, ViTs, CLIP-style and vision-language models) to new customer use cases with limited labeled data.
* Own data pipelines end to end: curation, labeling guidelines, augmentation, synthetic data, and dataset versioning.
* Optimize models for production and edge hardware using quantization, pruning, distillation, ONNX export and TensorRT, hitting agreed latency and accuracy targets.
* Build evaluation suites with clear metrics (mAP, precision/recall, false-alarm rates per camera-hour) and catch regressions before release.
* Deploy and monitor models in production, diagnose drift and failure cases, and close the loop with retraining.
* Work with product, solutions engineers and customers to turn vague requirements into measurable model specs.
* Write clean, tested, reviewed code and contribute to shared ML tooling.

Nice to have

* Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA-style models) or open-vocabulary detection.
* Multi-object tracking and video analytics (re-identification, action recognition, temporal models).
* Few-shot learning, active learning, or synthetic data generation for low-data domains.
* MLOps tooling: MLflow or Weights & Biases, Kubernetes, Triton Inference Server, CI/CD for models.
* Domain experience in Healthcare, retail and supply chain, manufacturing inspection, workplace safety or video surveillance.

Key Components

* Model Development and Optimization: Design, develop, and optimize machine learning models for computer vision applications.
* Data Management: Collaborate with ML engineers to ensure the collection, processing, and maintenance of high-quality datasets necessary for model training and testing.
* Algorithm Implementation: Implement state-of-the-art computer vision algorithms to improve system accuracy and performance in real-world scenarios.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely within the solutions engineering team to integrate machine learning models into the broader product and systems.
* On-Site Travel and Field Testing: Many of our projects are live deployments with major fortune 500 customers – testing new, innovative ML technologies. Traveling on site is sometimes needed to see the environment, test in the real-world, and ensure the technology is operating as expected.
* Performance Evaluation: Regularly evaluate the performance of computer vision models, using both qualitative and quantitative methods, and iterate to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
* Research and Innovation: Understanding of the latest developments in machine learning and computer vision, applying innovative approaches and technologies to solve complex challenges.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into effective technical solutions.
* Problem-Solving: Address and troubleshoot complex problems that arise during the development and deployment of computer vision systems.

The ideal candidate should be deeply passionate about machine learning and its real-world applications, particularly in improving and leveraging state-of-the-art neural networks to make an impact.

 **Requirements**  

* 3–5 years of industry experience building ML systems, with at least 2 years focused on computer vision.
* BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Math or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch (or TensorFlow) for training and debugging deep learning models.
* Shipped at least one computer vision model to production, and can explain the trade-offs made along the way.
* Solid grasp of CNN and transformer architectures for detection, segmentation and classification.
* Experience with OpenCV and image/video processing: decoding streams, preprocessing, augmentation.
* Working knowledge of model optimization for inference (ONNX, TensorRT, quantization or similar).
* Comfortable with Docker, Git, Linux and training on GPUs in a cloud environment (AWS/Azure).
* Sound ML fundamentals: loss functions, overfitting, class imbalance, evaluation metrics and experiment design.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining model behavior to non-ML stakeholders.

Chooch offers extensive benefits including health, dental, vision insurance, 401K with 3% match, extensive PTO, and life insurance policies included.

Everything we do is about making the future of human work more purposeful. We do this by leveraging state-of-the-art machine learning, generative AI, modern architectures, and industry experts to create AI-powered solutions that transform the way we do business.

We focus on building scalable AI solutions, based on rigorous data exploration, validation via proof-of-concept buildout, and close partnership with subject matter experts across business areas.
  
  
The future is powered by AI, come build it with us.

**Role Overview**

Crowe’s Studio team is seeking an AI Tech Lead to serve as a hands-on technical leader for the design, development, and lifecycle management of AI agents that accelerate the delivery of Crowe’s Audit services. This role is built around Crowe’s forward deployed engineer (FDE) model: rather than sitting above a project as a traditional program manager, this person sits with Audit practitioners, learns the workflow, designs the agent as it is built, and owns the outcome end to end. The goal is to establish the technical patterns, Skills-based architecture, and engineering practices needed to support a growing portfolio of agents. As that portfolio grows, the role is expected to grow into leading a small team as an engineering manager with full-stack engineers who each own a slice of the roadmap.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Delivery of Audit AI Agents**

* Own the design, development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of AI agents and agent-assisted workflows that accelerate the execution of common tasks across Crowe’s Audit practice.
* Operate as a forward deployed engineer paired directly with an Audit SME — sitting with practitioners, learning the workflow firsthand, and designing the agent as it is built rather than from a static spec.
* Remain hands-on in development: write, review, test, and maintain substantial Python codebases and the Skills, instructions, prompts, and supporting resources that define agent behavior.
* Manage project scope, timelines, and stakeholder communication for the agents you own — balancing hands-on delivery with the planning, prioritization, and coordination expected of a senior technical lead.
* Design and develop agents using a Skills-based architecture — modular, reusable capabilities that can be efficiently discovered, invoked, tested, maintained, and enhanced over time.
* Serve as the technical authority for the agent layer, making key design and implementation decisions while partnering with architects and engineering teams to ensure alignment with the broader Audit technology ecosystem.
* Implement and maintain monitoring, observability, and alerting for agents running in production, including trace-level visibility into agent reasoning and tool calls, to proactively detect, diagnose, and resolve issues.

**Build and Scale the Engineering Capability**

* Establish reusable engineering patterns and development practices that let a growing portfolio of agents be developed, evaluated, deployed, supported, and enhanced sustainably.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps to automate testing, evaluation, and deployment of agents across environments.
* As the portfolio grows, lead a small team of forward deployed engineers that advance the roadmap per the audit stakeholders they serve.
* Participate in the development and evolution of agent evaluation strategies, including representative test cases, automated evaluators, regression testing, quantifiable accuracy metrics, and processes for identifying and addressing changes in agent behavior.
* Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership, including code and design reviews, as the agent portfolio and supporting team grow.
* Promote collaboration across the Audit BU and the broader Studio to surface opportunities, share reusable patterns, and avoid duplicated build effort.

**Product Judgment**

* Think in terms of ROI, business case, and value pool for every initiative, defining and tracking KPIs to measure and communicate business impact; make product decisions directly alongside the SME rather than routing through a separate product owner.
* Demonstrate a solutions-oriented approach: be proactive, identify solutions independently, initiate activities, and follow through to completion.
* Leverage data and insights to shape and defend a point of view aligned to Audit’s business needs.
* Communicate proficiently with both technical staff and business leaders, articulating complex ideas, strategies, and recommendations in terms each audience can act on.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience developing, implementing, and supporting enterprise applications and services.
* 5+ years of professional Python development experience, with a strong track record of building enterprise-grade applications and services.
* Demonstrated ability to write clean, maintainable, modular, testable, and well-structured Python code designed for long-term support and scalability — production-grade software that does not create technical debt.
* 1+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and productionizing AI agents or AI-assisted workflows using a major AI platform or model provider such as Microsoft, Anthropic, or OpenAI.
* Hands-on experience developing agents using a Skills-based architecture, including authoring and maintaining Skills definitions, markdown-based instructions, supporting resources, and executable code used by agents.
* Experience testing and evaluating AI systems, including automated evaluators, representative test cases, regression testing, and analysis of agent failure modes.
* Demonstrated ability to embrace and advocate for AI-assisted software engineering practices, including the effective use of coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot), automated testing, and design-time AI tools to accelerate solution design, improve quality, and enhance developer productivity.
* Demonstrated project management experience — scoping, planning, and managing technical projects/initiatives end-to-end in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment — with a strong track record of proactive, independent problem-solving.
* Experience providing technical leadership to software engineering teams, including mentoring engineers, conducting code and design reviews, and establishing engineering practices and standards.
* Experience designing and deploying AI/ML solutions on major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP), including the use of managed AI services, cloud-native integration patterns, scalable data architectures, and secure, enterprise-grade deployments. Azure experience preferred
* Experience with Azure DevOps — including building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines — or a similar platform, and Git-based version control.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical work to non-technical business leaders and translate complex requirements into practical technical solutions alongside product managers, architects, and business stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Experience developing software or AI solutions for Audit, accounting, public accounting, financial services, or another regulated industry.
* Proficiency with modern AI/ML frameworks, tools, and agent platforms (e.g. MCP, A2A, Microsoft Foundry, OpenAI Agent SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework, Claude SDK, LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or equivalent). Knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, embeddings, and techniques for grounding model outputs in enterprise data.
* Experience delivering solutions with the Microsoft .NET stack, C#, and SQL Server.
* Experience helping establish or scale an engineering capability, including defining development standards, reusable patterns, and practices that support a growing team and portfolio of production solutions.
* Consulting, product management, investment banking, or startup experience that has developed strong commercial and product instincts.
* Prior experience as a forward deployed engineer or similar embedded technical role, partnering directly with subject matter experts to design and build workflow software without a separate product-owner layer.
* Demonstrated passion for sharing what you learn, whether by offering cross-training opportunities, giving internal team “lightning talks,” or by writing detailed comments on tickets when you close them.

title: Research Scientist – Neuroscience
description:
The Department of Anesthesiology, Perioperative and Pain Medicine at Stanford University School of Medicine is seeking a Research Scientist with a neuroscience background and expertise in electrophysiology, patch-clamp recording, and calcium imaging to join the Anderson Laboratory.

The Anderson Laboratory is a translational pain and neuromodulation laboratory investigating novel approaches to prevent and treat acute and chronic pain, with a major emphasis on diagnostic ultrasound-guided focused ultrasound for noninvasive peripheral nerve modulation. The laboratory integrates neuroscience, bioengineering, electrophysiology, behavioral models, imaging, and translational research to understand how focused ultrasound alters peripheral neural signaling and to develop this technology toward clinical application.

The Research Scientist will take a leading role in developing the laboratory's mechanistic neuroscience program. The individual will design and perform electrophysiologic and imaging experiments to determine how focused ultrasound and related interventions affect peripheral nerves and sensory neurons, with particular emphasis on neuronal excitability, nociceptive signaling, ion-channel function, and cellular responses.

The successful candidate will have substantial expertise in electrophysiology, patch clamp, and calcium imaging and will be expected to operate with considerable scientific independence. Responsibilities will include experimental design, development and optimization of new methodologies, execution and analysis of complex neuroscience experiments, interpretation of results, preparation of publications and grant applications, presentation of findings, and training and mentoring of junior research personnel.

This position provides an opportunity to participate in a highly multidisciplinary research program spanning fundamental neuroscience, bioengineering, preclinical models, and translation of novel neuromodulation technologies toward human studies.

**CORE DUTIES:**

Design and lead neuroscience experiments. Develop experimental strategies to investigate neuronal excitability, sensory signaling, peripheral nerve physiology, and mechanisms of neuromodulation. Independently establish experimental parameters, controls, endpoints, and analytical approaches.

Perform advanced electrophysiologic studies. Conduct electrophysiologic experiments including whole-cell and/or other patch-clamp recordings, extracellular electrophysiology, and related approaches to characterize neuronal membrane properties, ion-channel activity, action potential generation, synaptic or sensory signaling, and responses to experimental interventions.

Perform calcium imaging and functional neuronal imaging. Design and conduct calcium-imaging experiments in neuronal preparations; optimize acquisition protocols; perform quantitative image and signal analysis; and integrate imaging results with electrophysiologic and behavioral findings.

Analyze and interpret complex experimental data. Apply appropriate quantitative, statistical, electrophysiologic, and imaging analysis techniques. Integrate findings across experimental modalities and develop mechanistic hypotheses based on experimental results.

Develop and optimize experimental methods. Establish new techniques and protocols; troubleshoot instrumentation and experimental preparations; improve reproducibility and rigor; and recommend modifications to research approaches based on experimental findings and emerging scientific literature.

Scientific writing and dissemination. Contribute substantially to manuscripts, abstracts, presentations, research reports, and grant applications. Present research findings at laboratory meetings, departmental conferences, and scientific meetings.

Mentoring and scientific supervision. Train and mentor research assistants, graduate students, postdoctoral fellows, and other laboratory personnel in electrophysiology, patch clamp, calcium imaging, experimental design, data analysis, and rigorous scientific practices.

Laboratory and collaborative activities. Participate in multidisciplinary collaborations, maintain appropriate experimental documentation and data integrity, assist with equipment and laboratory organization related to neuroscience studies, and contribute to regulatory and research-compliance activities.

**QUALIFICATIONS / MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:**

PhD in neuroscience, neurobiology, physiology, biomedical engineering, pharmacology, or a closely related discipline is strongly preferred. Candidates should have substantial research experience in neuroscience and demonstrated expertise in electrophysiologic methods.

Strong candidates will have significant hands-on experience with patch-clamp electrophysiology, preferably including whole-cell recordings from neurons; calcium imaging, including experimental acquisition and quantitative analysis; neuronal or peripheral nerve electrophysiology; experimental design and troubleshooting of technically complex neuroscience experiments; quantitative analysis of electrophysiologic and imaging datasets; and preparation of manuscripts for peer-reviewed publication.

Experience with sensory neuroscience, pain neuroscience, peripheral nerves, dorsal root ganglion neurons, ion channels, neuromodulation, ultrasound, or related areas would be particularly valuable. Experience with animal models and ex vivo or in vitro neuronal preparations is also desirable.
